issues.concern: The English translation 'She has traces of her mother in her features' is unnatural and slightly misleading. 'Traces' implies something faint or barely perceptible, whereas 面影 (omokage) in this context often suggests a clear resemblance.
issues.suggestion: She resembles her mother in her features.

issues.concern: The English translation 'images of how things looked in my younger days came flooding back one after another' misrepresents the Japanese. The Japanese refers to 'traces/images of myself when I was young', not 'how things looked'.
issues.suggestion: As I flipped through the old album, images of my younger self came flooding back one after another.
